title: Thread design is horrible- extended run time makes very smooth smoothies
text:
Thread design is horrible- extended run time makes very smooth smoothies. This blender is pretty good yet doesn't quite earn a 5 star rating from me. Unlike a higher priced whole food processor (Blendtec or VitaMix, which I have owned for over 16 years) it still struggles with completely pulverizing small seeds and grains without extended run times. The worse aspect of this item is the thread design on the cups/blade assembly. The threads are on the inside of the blade assembly and the cups. No matter how tight I place the blade assembly to the cup there is leakage into the motor assembly. Also, when opening the cup the smoothie will have ran into the threads and therefore will begin to run down the sides of the cups and into the threads of the blade assembly. This makes is a bit of a mess to drink and also almost impossible to clean the threads of the blade assembly- this is horrible design flaw. I don’t use this item often due to this… if they were to fix this I would give it a higher rating.

UPDATE: The seller's CS rep emailed me about my less than great review and asked me to email them with my concerns. I emailed the CS rep on 01/26 and have yet to receive a reply.
